## About
Gourav Chawla is a Senior Analyst Data Engineer  based in Gurugram, India with 4+ years
of experience building enterprise data platforms on Google Cloud Platform.
Currently working at Accenture in the Retail domain processing 30GB+ daily.
Previously at Tata Consultancy Services in the Banking domain.

- Tools: dbt, PySpark, Apache Spark, Terraform, Docker, GitHub CI/CD
- AI Tools: Claude (Anthropic), GitHub Copilot, Antigravity
- Languages: Python, Advanced SQL, Shell Scripting
